description: Municipal Building Energy Use and Energy Star Score is a dataset listed in City of Providence open data portal (data.providenceri.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Providence. Energy data on Providence Municipal buildings by year. Coverage: Providence. The portal files it under the category Finance. Its tags are energy, sustainability. The table has 12 columns. Attribution on the portal: Energy Star Portfolio Manager. The portal shows 2017-12-21 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-providenceri-gov-portal.
